pages.text: Consumes Akaishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on geodes - the key to crystal automation.$(li)Basic: 3x3x3, 20% chance, 5 e/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5, 30%, 25 e/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9, 40%, 125 e/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16, 50%, 625 e/t
Geodes come in flawed/normal/pristine/perfect quality.$(br)Pair catalysts with collectors for fully automatic crystals.
